title: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim
description: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: GoTo / Kill

Quest Description: Find Vergrim's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, slay Vergrim's Ghost, then return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Ghost of Whiskers Past - Vergrim Vengeance

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find Vergrim's Revenge off of The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, slay Vergrim's Ghost, then return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

It looks like Ratsputin has added the most powerful trapped soul to his collection: Vergrim. Now, I went to daycare with Vergrim and I know he is not one to be taken easily and that is a testament to just how powerful Ratsputin has become. Are you scared yet? No, well...I'm not either! The shaking in my hands is actually a Self Buff skill called The Jitters that I cast while you weren't looking. Seriously, I'm not scared. You SHOULD be since you are the one that is going to be fighting Vergrim's Ghost. You figured that out already, right? Right!

If Ratsputin really has captured Vergrim's soul then that means he has the three most powerful, and influential, Whiskers in the world doing his bidding. The good thing is that since I've been sending you in to battle these spirits they are all really mad at you and if push comes to shove they would probably be ok with just destroying you and leaving the rest of us alone. And that is why I get paid the big King's Coin.

Find Vergrim's Revenge off of the Whisker's Library - Dogma Section, which is off of Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Once you have found Vergrim's Ghost's lair I want you to slay the apparition. Do this and return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston for your reward.

Turn-in:

You busted the ghost?! Well done.

Objectives:

  • Locate Vergrim's Revenge
  • Slay Vergrim's Ghost

Client level range: 79–100
